verdict.rationale: The only send-timing evidence is the MCP page saying Superhuman Mail can draft follow-up nudges and 'send when each recipient is most likely to open it.' That implies first-party deferred sending, but only in an AI follow-up context, not as a user-chosen schedule-send feature. Nothing in the pack mentions undo send or a grace window. Missing for 10: documented user-facing schedule-send with chosen date/time, undo-send grace window, independent or hands-on corroboration.
